name: app-vehicle-selection-screen-label-strip-with-caption
title: Wide white strip with an outlined 'Vehicle selection screen' pill and a right-aligned caption
whatItIs: A thin white strip with an outlined pill 'VEHICLE SELECTION SCREEN' at the left and a small uppercase caption at the right, part black and part grey, explaining three vehicles on one screen.
whatItMeans: Quiet and explanatory; a divider that names the next screen.
techniques: Label a section with an outlined pill.
Set a caption in two tones.

vocabulary.definition: A pill naming the screen shown below.
